what_this_is: The closed population of the ENGINE-NEUTRALITY doctrine (scripts/check_engine_neutrality.sh): which grammars are LANGUAGES the engine must not know and which are the engine's own META languages; which rust/src files are NOT the neutral engine (a per-family component, the derived registry, the embedding API, the operator binaries, the test harnesses) and how many language tokens each still carries in production code — a ceiling that only FALLS, each non-zero one owned by the leaf that removes it. Every file no class names is the ENGINE and may carry none. A grammar or file with no row FAILS the gate; a row naming nothing FAILS it.
the_rule: ENGINE-UNIVERSAL-SERVICES, the frame (director, 2026-08-11): a concern belongs to the ENGINE iff it is objectively shared by all EBNFs — a property of parsing, not of the language parsed; it belongs to the GRAMMAR iff it is a fact about one language. The director, 2026-09-28: neutrality and agnosticity are the whole point of PGEN; a silent violation is unacceptable and must be mechanically prevented.
_grammar_classes_note: language = a parser PGEN builds for users (its name, @profiles, kw_* tokens and multi-word rule names are forbidden in the engine); meta = the engine's own languages (the EBNF meta-grammar, the two annotation languages, the example grammars regex and json whose words — `regex`, `number`, `quoted_string` — are engine vocabulary by construction).
_file_classes_note: per-family: a language-specific COMPONENT (it may name its own family — its name, its profiles, its rules — and nothing of another's). DERIVED BY PATH since ENGINE-UNIVERSAL-SERVICES.113: every rust/src/families/<name>.rs and every file under rust/src/families/<name>/ is that family's component and needs no row here (the SystemVerilog preprocessor and its keyword tables live under rust/src/families/systemverilog/, published to the engine as one neutral preprocessing stage); the rows listed are the components that live elsewhere (a family's own contract probe under bin/); registry: the enumeration of registered generated parsers (derived by build.rs from generated/); api: the shipped embedding surface — its family / profile enumeration is owed to derivation from the registry and the generated parsers' declared profiles; bin: operator tools (build / measure / debug), not shipped to users; harness: test suites and censuses that name families as fixtures. Everything else is the ENGINE.

rust/src/bin/parseability_probe.rs.why_non_zero: the probe's SystemVerilog preprocess flags and the family-specific dump paths

_ceilings_note: production-code language tokens per classed file, measured 2026-09-28 on 7ac640e94 by `--census`; a rise FAILS, a fall is promoted with `--rebaseline`; every non-zero ceiling names the leaf that owes its zero — the doctrine's end state is every ceiling at 0. ENGINE-UNIVERSAL-SERVICES.112 (2026-09-29) took the api / registry rows to 0 and .113 (2026-09-29) the bin / harness rows; a row at 0 names no owner.
_engine_allow_note: EMPTY by design. A row here is a language token the ENGINE is temporarily allowed to carry; it needs `file`, `token`, `reason` and `owner_leaf`, and the gate refuses a row without them. Nothing is allowed today: the three strings measured on 7ac640e94 (annotation_validator.rs:852, grammar_wellformedness.rs:338, semantic_runtime.rs:716) were made neutral in this doctrine's own commit.
